reviews.name: Ahmad Asnawie
reviews.text: … The entire process was incredibly smooth, well-guided, and fast. The team didn’t just “process an application” — they actually took time to understand our situation and recommended the right solution based on our real needs. …

reviews.name: Fitryy Fitryy
reviews.text: Very thankful to Ms Fyera for helping my family find a suitable helper. Their customer service is excellent and very easy to communicate with. The maid is well-mannered, responsible, and helpful with house chores and childcare. Overall, a pleasant experience and worth recommending to others

reviews.name: Leong Jia Jun
reviews.text: Very pleased with Final Choice Agency, especially Yuki and Ms. Ng. They helped us carefully screen candidates and ensured only quality maids were shortlisted for our selection. Even on weekends, they were always responsive and answered our calls. They also provide training to the maids to ensure they are well-prepared before joining their new families. Will definitely recommend them to others who are looking for helpers.

reviews.name: Gevenia Bae
reviews.text:
Super recommend Miss Ng and Eunice!
Since it was my first time hiring a helper, I was quite nervous about not getting the right one. But thanks to Miss Ng’s careful matching, I finally got a helper who fits me so well. She looks after my baby and also handles all the housework — honestly, it has made my life so much easier!

reviews.name: Chua Soo Jun
reviews.text:
Professional and Trustworthy Agency
Highly recommended! Eunice and Ms Ng were patient, professional, and really listened to our needs. They helped us find a maid that matched exactly what we were looking for and gave us all the information we needed. The maid recommended for my baby is caring, gentle, and well-trained. Truly grateful for their support.
